```{r}
params <- list(
  
  previous_output_root =
    "bootstrap_stable_analysis",

  
  original_crc_de_dir =
    "data/DE_results",

  
  comparison_output_dir =
    "bootstrap_stable_analysis/results/bootstrap_comparison",

  
  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
  logfc_cutoff = 1,

  
  
  
  
  bootstrap_assessed_contrasts = c(
    "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
  )
)

contrast_names <- c(
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H",
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L",
  "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
)

required_packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "tidyr",
  "tibble",
  "ggplot2",
  "openxlsx",
  "svglite",
  "knitr"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required R packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6
)

stable_crc_de_dir <- file.path(
  params$previous_output_root,
  "data",
  "DE_results",
  "CRC"
)

stable_crc_only_dir <- file.path(
  stable_crc_de_dir,
  "stable_only"
)

previous_stable_gene_file <- file.path(
  params$previous_output_root,
  "bootstrap_stable_genes_all_contrasts.csv"
)

previous_stable_count_file <- file.path(
  params$previous_output_root,
  "bootstrap_stable_gene_counts.csv"
)

dir.create(
  params$comparison_output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  }

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

safe_max_abs <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)

  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  max(abs(x), na.rm = TRUE)
}

safe_percentage <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(denominator) | denominator == 0,
    NA_real_,
    round(100 * numerator / denominator, 2)
  )
}
```

```{r}
input_manifest <- tibble(
  Contrast = contrast_names,
  Bootstrap_assessed =
    contrast_names %in% params$bootstrap_assessed_contrasts,

  Original_DE_file = file.path(
    params$original_crc_de_dir,
    paste0(contrast_names, ".csv")
  ),

  Stable_full_file = file.path(
    stable_crc_de_dir,
    paste0(contrast_names, ".csv")
  ),

  Stable_only_file = file.path(
    stable_crc_only_dir,
    paste0(contrast_names, ".csv")
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Original_exists = file.exists(Original_DE_file),
    Stable_full_exists = file.exists(Stable_full_file),
    Stable_only_exists = file.exists(Stable_only_file)
  )

knitr::kable(
  input_manifest,
  caption = "Input files used for the comparison"
)

missing_required_files <- input_manifest %>%
  filter(!Original_exists | !Stable_full_exists)

if (nrow(missing_required_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Required input files are missing:\n",
    paste(
      apply(
        missing_required_files,
        1,
        function(x) {
          paste(
            x[["Contrast"]],
            "original exists =", x[["Original_exists"]],
            "stable exists =", x[["Stable_full_exists"]]
          )
        }
      ),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  )
}

if (any(!input_manifest$Stable_only_exists)) {
  warning(
    "One or more stable-only files are missing. ",
    "The main comparison can still be performed using the ",
    "bootstrap_stable column in the full stable files."
  )
}
```

```{r}
read_deg_file <- function(file, require_stability_column = FALSE) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    stop("File does not exist: ", file)
  }

  tab <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  tab <- tibble::rownames_to_column(
    tab,
    var = "Gene"
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c("logFC", "FDR")

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(tab)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in ",
      file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      "\nAvailable columns: ",
      paste(names(tab), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (
    require_stability_column &&
    !"bootstrap_stable" %in% names(tab)
  ) {
    stop(
      "The stable result file does not contain bootstrap_stable: ",
      file
    )
  }

  tab <- tab %>%
    mutate(
      Gene = trimws(as.character(Gene)),
      logFC = as.numeric(logFC),
      FDR = as.numeric(FDR)
    )

  if ("PValue" %in% names(tab)) {
    tab$PValue <- as.numeric(tab$PValue)
  }

  if ("logCPM" %in% names(tab)) {
    tab$logCPM <- as.numeric(tab$logCPM)
  }

  if ("bootstrap_stable" %in% names(tab)) {
    tab$bootstrap_stable <- as_flag(
      tab$bootstrap_stable
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(tab$Gene) > 0) {
    duplicated_genes <- unique(
      tab$Gene[duplicated(tab$Gene)]
    )

    stop(
      "Duplicated gene identifiers found in ",
      file,
      ": ",
      paste(head(duplicated_genes, 20), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  tab
}
```

```{r}
comparison_list <- vector(
  "list",
  length(contrast_names)
)

names(comparison_list) <- contrast_names

for (contrast_name in contrast_names) {
  original_file <- file.path(
    params$original_crc_de_dir,
    paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
  )

  stable_file <- file.path(
    stable_crc_de_dir,
    paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
  )

  stable_only_file <- file.path(
    stable_crc_only_dir,
    paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
  )

  original_tab <- read_deg_file(
    original_file,
    require_stability_column = FALSE
  )

  stable_tab <- read_deg_file(
    stable_file,
    require_stability_column = TRUE
  )

  if (file.exists(stable_only_file)) {
    stable_only_tab <- read_deg_file(
      stable_only_file,
      require_stability_column = TRUE
    )

    stable_only_genes <- stable_only_tab$Gene
  } else {
    stable_only_genes <- character(0)
  }

  stable_for_join <- stable_tab %>%
    transmute(
      Gene,
      stable_file_logFC = logFC,
      stable_file_FDR = FDR,
      bootstrap_stable_from_file = bootstrap_stable
    )

  contrast_assessed <-
    contrast_name %in% params$bootstrap_assessed_contrasts

  comparison_tab <- original_tab %>%
    left_join(
      stable_for_join,
      by = "Gene"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Contrast = contrast_name,
      Bootstrap_assessed = contrast_assessed,

      Stable_record_found =
        !is.na(bootstrap_stable_from_file),

      Stable_only_record_found =
        Gene %in% stable_only_genes,

      Original_significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        !is.na(logFC) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,

      Original_direction = case_when(
        Original_significant & logFC > 0 ~ "Up",
        Original_significant & logFC < 0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "Not significant"
      ),

      logFC_difference =
        stable_file_logFC - logFC,

      FDR_difference =
        stable_file_FDR - FDR
    )

  if (contrast_assessed) {
    comparison_tab <- comparison_tab %>%
      mutate(
        Bootstrap_stable = coalesce(
          bootstrap_stable_from_file,
          FALSE
        ),

        Bootstrap_stable_DE =
          Original_significant &
          Bootstrap_stable,

        Comparison_status = case_when(
          !Original_significant ~
            "Not significant in original DE",

          !Stable_record_found ~
            "Original DEG missing from stable full file",

          Bootstrap_stable ~
            "Original DEG passed bootstrap",

          TRUE ~
            "Original DEG failed bootstrap"
        )
      )
  } else {
    comparison_tab <- comparison_tab %>%
      mutate(
        Bootstrap_stable = NA,

        Bootstrap_stable_DE = NA,

        Comparison_status = case_when(
          Original_significant ~
            "Original DEG; contrast not assessed by bootstrap",

          TRUE ~
            "Not significant in original DE"
        )
      )
  }

  comparison_list[[contrast_name]] <- comparison_tab
}

comparison_all <- bind_rows(
  comparison_list
)

cat(
  "Total tested gene rows:",
  nrow(comparison_all),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
qc_summary <- comparison_all %>%
  group_by(
    Contrast,
    Bootstrap_assessed
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Original_rows = n(),

    Rows_found_in_stable_full_file =
      sum(Stable_record_found),

    Rows_missing_from_stable_full_file =
      sum(!Stable_record_found),

    Maximum_absolute_logFC_difference =
      safe_max_abs(logFC_difference),

    Maximum_absolute_FDR_difference =
      safe_max_abs(FDR_difference),

    Stable_flag_vs_stable_only_mismatches =
      if (first(Bootstrap_assessed)) {
        sum(
          Stable_record_found &
            (
              bootstrap_stable_from_file !=
                Stable_only_record_found
            ),
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },

    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  qc_summary,
  digits = 8,
  caption = "Quality-control comparison of original and stable files"
)

if (
  any(
    qc_summary$Rows_missing_from_stable_full_file > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  warning(
    "Some original genes are missing from the stable full files. ",
    "They are treated as not passing bootstrap for assessed contrasts."
  )
}

if (
  any(
    qc_summary$Maximum_absolute_logFC_difference > 1e-12,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) ||
  any(
    qc_summary$Maximum_absolute_FDR_difference > 1e-12,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  warning(
    "Original and stable full files contain different edgeR statistics. ",
    "Inspect the QC table before interpreting the comparison."
  )
}
```

```{r}
comparison_summary <- comparison_all %>%
  group_by(
    Contrast,
    Bootstrap_assessed
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Genes_tested = n(),

    Original_DE_genes =
      sum(Original_significant, na.rm = TRUE),

    Original_upregulated =
      sum(
        Original_significant & logFC > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Original_downregulated =
      sum(
        Original_significant & logFC < 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Bootstrap_stable_DE_genes =
      if (first(Bootstrap_assessed)) {
        sum(
          Bootstrap_stable_DE,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },

    Bootstrap_stable_upregulated =
      if (first(Bootstrap_assessed)) {
        sum(
          Bootstrap_stable_DE & logFC > 0,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },

    Bootstrap_stable_downregulated =
      if (first(Bootstrap_assessed)) {
        sum(
          Bootstrap_stable_DE & logFC < 0,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },

    Original_DE_genes_failing_bootstrap =
      if (first(Bootstrap_assessed)) {
        sum(
          Original_significant &
            !Bootstrap_stable,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },

    Original_DE_genes_missing_stability_record =
      if (first(Bootstrap_assessed)) {
        sum(
          Original_significant &
            !Stable_record_found,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      } else {
        NA_integer_
      },

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Retained_percent = safe_percentage(
      Bootstrap_stable_DE_genes,
      Original_DE_genes
    ),

    Removed_percent = safe_percentage(
      Original_DE_genes_failing_bootstrap,
      Original_DE_genes
    )
  )

knitr::kable(
  comparison_summary,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Original DEGs compared with bootstrap-stable DEGs"
)
```

```{r}
preferred_gene_columns <- c(
  "Contrast",
  "Gene",
  "logFC",
  "logCPM",
  "F",
  "PValue",
  "FDR",
  "Original_direction",
  "Stable_record_found",
  "Stable_only_record_found",
  "Bootstrap_stable",
  "Comparison_status"
)

genes_not_passing_bootstrap <- comparison_all %>%
  filter(
    Bootstrap_assessed,
    Original_significant,
    !Bootstrap_stable
  ) %>%
  select(
    any_of(preferred_gene_columns),
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    FDR,
    desc(abs(logFC))
  )

genes_passing_bootstrap <- comparison_all %>%
  filter(
    Bootstrap_assessed,
    Original_significant,
    Bootstrap_stable
  ) %>%
  select(
    any_of(preferred_gene_columns),
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    FDR,
    desc(abs(logFC))
  )

all_original_de_genes <- comparison_all %>%
  filter(Original_significant) %>%
  select(
    any_of(preferred_gene_columns),
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    FDR,
    desc(abs(logFC))
  )

unassessed_original_de_genes <- comparison_all %>%
  filter(
    !Bootstrap_assessed,
    Original_significant
  ) %>%
  select(
    any_of(preferred_gene_columns),
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    FDR,
    desc(abs(logFC))
  )

failed_counts <- genes_not_passing_bootstrap %>%
  count(
    Contrast,
    Original_direction,
    name = "Genes_not_passing"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    Original_direction
  )

cat(
  "Original significant genes failing bootstrap:",
  nrow(genes_not_passing_bootstrap),
  "\n"
)

knitr::kable(
  failed_counts,
  caption = "Genes not passing bootstrap by contrast and direction"
)
```

```{r}
plot_count_data <- comparison_summary %>%
  filter(Bootstrap_assessed) %>%
  select(
    Contrast,
    Original_DE_genes,
    Bootstrap_stable_DE_genes
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Original_DE_genes,
      Bootstrap_stable_DE_genes
    ),
    names_to = "Analysis",
    values_to = "Number_of_genes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Analysis = recode(
      Analysis,
      Original_DE_genes = "Original DE",
      Bootstrap_stable_DE_genes =
        "Original DE + bootstrap stability"
    )
  )

if (nrow(plot_count_data) > 0) {
  p_counts <- ggplot(
    plot_count_data,
    aes(
      x = Contrast,
      y = Number_of_genes,
      fill = Analysis
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.72
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Number_of_genes),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      vjust = -0.3,
      size = 3.8
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Original versus bootstrap-stable CRC DEGs",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of significant genes",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 25,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      legend.position = "top"
    ) +
    expand_limits(
      y = max(plot_count_data$Number_of_genes) * 1.12
    )

  print(p_counts)

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      params$comparison_output_dir,
      "original_vs_bootstrap_DEG_counts.svg"
    ),
    p_counts,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 5.5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      params$comparison_output_dir,
      "original_vs_bootstrap_DEG_counts.pdf"
    ),
    p_counts,
    width = 8.5,
    height = 5.5
  )
}
```
